title: Create the semantic PlotSpec core
objective: Implement a minimal strict-Python versioned PlotSpec model, stable layer IDs, deterministic serialization, provenance, structured diagnostics, and checked schemas without yet changing Graphics or Graphics3d

oracles: Focused PlotSpec schema, serialization, and CPython/Sage.js differential tests

handoff.summary: Implemented and pushed strict ordinary-Python PlotSpec, PlotLayer, and Provenance models; deterministic ordinal layer IDs and collision allocation; detached deterministic JSON materialization with Plotly-compatible null gaps; an append-only structured diagnostics model/registry; checked PlotSpec and diagnostics schemas; and focused byte-identical CPython/Sage.js differential tests. Root integrated the core as d84d4746 and resolved central ownership, strict-module, standalone-closure, and test-manifest wiring in 226f2dfc, where focused, strict, architecture, and standalone checks pass.
risks: Ordinal IDs are stable across layer revisions, but composition code must preserve unique IDs and use next_layer_id for deterministic collision remapping.

Materialization intentionally normalizes NaN and both infinities to JSON null, so validation must diagnose the source data before or while constructing a layer when the exact non-finite category matters.

The pre-integration task branch cannot obtain its original broad pnpm test:integration receipt because package ownership and manifest wiring live in root integration commit 226f2dfc; root validation is the authoritative integrated result.
next_steps: Build semantic point, line, and text layers in Graphics and Graphics3d using the integrated sagejs.plotting package.
Validate Plotly overrides at the lowering boundary; the core deliberately checks only that they are JSON objects.
Represent frontend grouping through source_intent and metadata initially, then add a first-class group layer only if real Sage/Wolfram/MATLAB slices demonstrate a shared need.
